title: Guided Pre-Purchase Inspection (PPI)
tagline: Step-by-step diagnostic test plans and live health logging.
description: Standard scanners passively read fault codes. PeeweeSys guides you through an active diagnostic inspection plan: checking module states, guiding you through cold and hot engine startup routines, logging real-time telemetry, and compiling an authoritative PDF health dossier for prospective buyers and owners.
highlights: Guided interactive workflows: ignition on, engine crank, warm-up logging, actuator testing
Automatic multi-module consistency check (DME hours, Kombi mileage, transmission run-time)
Generates an immutable inspection dossier with freeze frames and live sensor graphs

title: Coolant Gauge Linearization
tagline: Eliminate the factory 80°C–105°C dummy flat-spot buffer.
description: From the factory, Porsche programmed the 986 and 996 coolant gauge needle to stay dead-center at 80°C (180°F) whether your actual engine coolant is 80°C, 95°C, or 105°C to avoid customer service inquiries. A true enthusiast wants to know their real temperature without artificial dampening. PeeweeSys linearizes the cluster interpolation table in EEPROM so the needle reflects reality.
highlights: Removes factory artificial dampening so your needle tells the truth
Inspect the exact 4-point temperature-to-impulse calibration table in cluster memory
Calculates the linearized curve so you actually see your engine warming up and cooling down

title: Speedometer Recalibration
tagline: Fix 4–7% factory over-read and compensate for aftermarket wheels.
description: Nearly all modern classic Porsche instrument clusters intentionally over-read speed by 4 to 8 km/h at highway speeds. True enthusiasts want GPS-calibrated precision. PeeweeSys extracts and adjusts the speedometer impulse factor `K-Zahl` stored in the cluster EEPROM, letting you dial in true vehicle speed or compensate for custom tire diameters.
highlights: Direct impulse coefficient calculation for GPS accuracy
Compensates for aftermarket wheel diameters and tire aspect ratios
Pre-verified against Porsche factory calibration guidelines

title: Full ECU ROM & EEPROM Dumps Over OBD
tagline: Direct memory extraction without desoldering or opening the ECU.
description: Standard diagnostic tools restrict you to basic OBD-II codes. PeeweeSys unlocks full memory-read service 0x23 to stream raw flash and EEPROM data over the standard 16-pin OBD port. Verified on Bosch ME7.2 DME and Siemens / VDO Kombi instrument clusters (2048-byte 93C86 dumps).
highlights: Exact byte-for-byte binary dump of cluster calibration & DME maps
Safely verified with non-destructive, read-only memory boundary checks
Instant offline backup before any instrument cluster modification

title: Multi-Module Tamper Detection
description: Unscrupulous sellers can adjust the digits on the instrument cluster, but rarely know how to falsify the independent run-time registers stored in the DME, ABS unit, or Tiptronic transmission. Integrated into our PPI workflow, PeeweeSys pulls all registers simultaneously into one tamper-audit view.
highlights: Simultaneous reading of DME hours, Kombi odometer, and transmission operating time
Highlights statistical discrepancies (e.g. suspiciously low average speed under 20 km/h)
Zero subscription lock-in — scan any car before you buy

title: Pre-Clear Snapshot Reports
tagline: Never lose critical diagnostic freeze frame data again.
description: Generic scan tools erase fault codes blindly with a single press, destroying freeze frame conditions (engine RPM, engine temp, load) needed to pinpoint intermittent misfires. PeeweeSys enforces a non-destructive snapshot workflow with structured export before clearing.
highlights: Captures all DTCs, freeze frames, and module versions into a permanent HTML/PDF dossier
Strict car-tested whitelist prevents sending unverified clear commands to sensitive ECUs
Automatic post-clear re-scan confirms whether faults are static or transient
